placementAdvice.text: Add Item owns its fixed cell; a Form Upload or another public layout owns the row gaps, wrapping and the surrounding label.

from.quote: A FormUpload or another public layout owns row gaps, wrapping, and the surrounding label.

placementAdvice.text: In an attachment row, cells keep the same footprint while the row controls spacing.

from.quote: Cells keep the same footprint while the row controls spacing.

configuration.text: The state is empty by default: the cell shows the add icon.
Empty can call onPress or an injected picker.

from.quote: Empty can call onPress or an injected picker.

configuration.text: For the add trigger, use picker with onAssetsPicked, or wire a platform-specific onPress.

from.quote: Use picker with onAssetsPicked, or wire a platform-specific onPress.

configuration.text: With picker set, onPress is ignored in the empty state: pressing the cell opens the picker, and the picked assets reach onAssetsPicked.
Preview needs an image source: set state to preview with imageSource to show what was chosen.

from.quote: Supply preview plus imageSource to show what was chosen.

configuration.text: In preview, onPress is called when the cell is pressed, for example to open a larger view of the image.
onRemove is optional: setting it shows the remove control, which calls it with no event argument.
Omit onRemove when the selected attachment cannot be cleared here.

from.quote: Omit onRemove when the selected attachment cannot be cleared here.

configuration.text: Show the unavailable state with isDisabled rather than a new visual variant.

from.quote: Unavailable uses the public isDisabled behavior rather than a new visual variant.

configuration.text: The inner IconCapsule icons default to AppearanceBrand Neutral, Emphasis Low and Icon Capsule Size S; any key passed in modes overrides those defaults.

examples.purpose: Add Item inside a Form Upload, the guide's In context: the field “Identity documents” with its support text, one of two attachments added, shown as a preview cell, and the add cell for the second. Form Upload builds the Add Item cells itself from attachments. The uri is a placeholder for the app's file; the onAttachmentsChange stub and the picker stub stand for the app's own list of files and its picker.
examples.jsx:
<FormUpload
  label="Identity documents"
  supportText="Add a clear image and keep the filename nearby."
  attachments={[{ uri: 'https://example.com/receipt-september.svg', name: 'receipt-september.svg' }]}
  maxCount={2}
  picker={async () => ({ assets: [] })}
  onAttachmentsChange={() => {}}
/>

from.quote: The public composite supplies the field label, support text, attachment row, picker handoff, and controlled attachment list.

examples.purpose: A chosen receipt with a meaningful label beside it, the guide's Do “Keep a meaningful label nearby”: a preview Add Item with its remove control, next to the text “Receipt · September”. The uri is a placeholder for the chosen image, onRemove stands for the screen clearing the attachment, and accessibilityLabel names the preview.
examples.jsx:
<HStack alignVertical="center">
  <Additem
    state="preview"
    imageSource="https://example.com/receipt-september.svg"
    onRemove={() => {}}
    accessibilityLabel="Receipt attachment preview"
  />
  <Text text="Receipt · September" />
</HStack>

from.quote: The attachment remains identifiable even when the image is small.

props.name: state
props.description: Visual state of the item. - `'empty'` — shows the add/upload icon (default). - `'preview'` — shows `imageSource`; remove overlay appears only when `onRemove` is set. Default "empty", from the component source.

props.name: imageSource
props.description: Image to preview when `state` is `'preview'`. Accepts the same shapes as the library's `Image` component (remote URI string, `{ uri }`, or `require()`).

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the cell is pressed. Ignored for `'empty'` when `picker` is set. Use for empty without picker, or for preview (e.g. lightbox).

props.name: onRemove
props.description: The remove control is a button placed next to the preview button, not inside it, named “Remove” plus the cell's label (“Remove Receipt 1” in a Form Upload); a mouse click and Enter both remove, and a standalone Add Item's remove doesn't trigger open. Declared: Called when the remove icon overlay is pressed in `'preview'` mode. When set, the close `IconCapsule` is shown. No event argument is passed.

props.name: picker
props.description: Optional picker to invoke when the empty cell is pressed. When provided, `onPress` is ignored for the empty state and the cell becomes a real upload trigger that resolves with picked assets via `onAssetsPicked`.

props.name: onAssetsPicked
props.description: Called after a successful picker invocation with the selected assets.

props.name: modes
props.description: The inner IconCapsule still defaults to Neutral, Low and S. Declared: Modes for design-token resolution. Defaults to Neutral / Low / Icon Capsule Size S for the inner `IconCapsule` icons; any key supplied here overrides those defaults.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label. Defaults to a descriptive label based on state.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disabled cells render at 0.5 opacity once. Declared: Disables press interaction. Also dims the cell. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: testID
props.description: In preview, testID lands on a wrapper holding the preview button, the image and the remove button. Declared: Test identifier.
